punchline: Mice ate the same calories of the same food; the ones limited to an 8-hour window weighed 28 percent less.
thirty_sec: Panda's lab fed mice the same fatty diet. Free eaters gained weight and developed liver damage; mice limited to 8 hours a night weighed 28 percent less. Panda said human studies were needed. A pilot with eight people eating within 10 to 11 hours reported better energy and sleep.
